rows.definition: Session-owned resident F32 indexer-key matrices keyed by immutable publication ownership, source and geometry identity, with live handles charged across callback rebinding. Admission requires an explicit positive index-key byte allowance that defaults to zero; unchanged history reuses its exact buffer, append stages only new rows while copying the old device prefix, and invalidated identity reseeds.
rows.distinction: Separate from attention KV state and model-owned immutable weight staging. It owns indexer score inputs, charges retained plus replacement/staging peak, and retires replaced storage only after checked score read; append still incurs O(history) device copies. No production default or hardware-performance qualification.
